g.text: Covariate value the study speaks for (centre, 10th-90th)
area = n | round + bar: marginalised over a distribution | diamond: conditioned at one value
dashed blue: lm across studies, a SLOPE is a mis-specified form | grey: one source's strata, a consistent TILT is the same
z averaged over times, which are correlated, so +/-1.96 is indicative not a test
